page.overview:
Who is Raptor?

Raptor is a common, informal name for the dinosaur family , which includes most dinosaurs with the -raptor suffix and .

Due to the "velociraptors" in the 1993 film Jurassic Park actually being based on Deinonychus, popular concepts of most raptors, especially in fiction, are based on this portrayal, no matter what to which they are supposed to belong.

Raptors are a common enemy in the underground stages of the TMNT 2: Battle Nexus. They hatch from eggs and spring out to attack, or drop from the ceiling. They also appear as foes in the Battle Nexus mode.
